Subject: POC Kickoff Recap: Acme / Redwood Inference

Hi Lena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment ahead of the POC kickoff: 

Pain points you called out:
- Slow search/retrieval and inconsistent summarization across support tickets (current LLM pipeline has high latency at 90th/95th).
- Cost volatility during peak batch processing.
- Difficulty reproducing prod-level prompt/eval regressions across environments.

Goals for the 6-week POC (what success looks like):
1) Reduce customer-facing summary latency (p95) to <= 300ms for the canonical prompt set.
2) Demonstrate >= 20% reduction in token cost per session (compared to current baseline) through intelligent batching and KV caching.
3) Establish an eval harness with 200 representative prompts and clear quality thresholds (ROUGE/ROUGE-L + manual spot checks).

Scope / deliverables: 
- Provide Redwood sandbox environment and dedicated project for Acme.
- Load a sample prompt set (you agreed to share ~200 prompts/annotations).
- Run baseline evals, then one optimization pass (batching + quantization recommendations).
- Weekly checkpoints (tech sync) and one executive review at week 4.

Owners (per call):
- Acme: Lena Ortiz (Product Owner), Tom Baker (Solutions Architect)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, engagement lead), Aditya Rao (Platform engineer, setup/onboarding), Rishi Malhotra (SRE/Perf, latency/cost targets)

Timeline (proposed):
- Week of Feb 16: sandbox provisioned + onboarding call
- Week of Feb 23: baseline evals complete
- Week of Mar 1: optimization pass + QA
- Week of Mar 8: final results + executive review

Immediate asks for kickoff:
- Please share the 200-sample prompt set and a sample of anonymized ticket text (S3/Drive link or upload).
- Confirm PO contact for network/firewall access (if needed) and security questionnaire owner.

Attached: POC-SOW.pdf (proposal + SOW). I can send DocuSign once you confirm the timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
